# stdx.template

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Templates in Jinja syntax (`{{ value }}`, `{% for x in xs %}`, `{% if %}`,
filters such as `upper` and `join`, `{% include %}`, `{% extends %}`):
a template renders a value (any `Codec` value, seen through its
schema). HTML rendering escapes values; a misspelled name is an error,
not empty output. The `badger_template` native module (minijinja)
renders.

## Types

### `Error`

```badger
struct Error { pub message: String }
```

A template that does not parse, or names something the value lacks.

#### `Error.display`

```badger
fn display(self: &Self) -> String
```

### `Templates`

```badger
struct Templates { handle: native.Handle }
```

Named templates compiled once, which may include and extend each other.

#### `Templates.render`

```badger
fn render<T>(self: &Self, name: String, value: T) -> Result<String, Error> where T: Codec
```

Render the template `name` with `value`.

### `render`

